claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nimesulide is a COX-2-selective NSAID that at 2.5 uM is not expected to kill cancer cells through COX inhibition; any antiproliferative effect would likely reflect weak, non-specific cytotoxicity rather than a defined mechanism.
